text: I understand this is frustrating, and I appreciate your patience. Since you're unable to provide the address details needed for the system updates, and this is outside the scope of what I can handle with the available tools, I think the best option would be to transfer you to a human agent who may be able to assist you with alternative methods for updating your address.
zh: 我理解这很令人沮丧，也感谢您的耐心。由于您无法提供系统更新所需的地址详细信息，并且这超出了我使用现有工具可以处理的范围，我认为最好的选择是转接给一位人类客服，看看他们是否能以替代方法帮助您更新地址。
